# Support Policy

This is an open-source project provided "as-is" without any formal support guarantees. 


## Guidelines

* **No Tech Support:** I provide limited setup help or answering troubleshooting questions, at my discretion.
* **Bugs Only:** The issue tracker is strictly for reporting verifiable bugs. 
* **Unrelated Issues:** Any issue opened to ask a question may be closed immediately, or may be answered, time limited, because I am 62 years old.

Thank you for your understanding.
